description.text: Program Introduction: The Industrial Engineering is based on the technology of mechanical engineering and electronic engineering, and takes the theory and method of industrial engineering as the link, and develops the planning, design, evaluation and innovation of the enterprise production system by means of operations research, human engineering, facility planning, computer technology and modern integrated manufacturing technology. Modern manufacturing senior management talents and logistics professionals combined with technology and management. Future Career: 1.Industrial engineering designers are engaged in management work in multinational corporations, foreign-funded enterprises, state-owned enterprises and private enterprises, so as to increase productivity and reduce costs. 2.Quality management - the quality management of industrial production enterprises, because industrial engineering students master mechanical design, production management, man-machine engineering, quality management and other professional knowledge, can be quickly integrated into the quality management work. At the same time, many enterprises have no industrial engineering department, so the lean production, system improvement and other related work are completed by the quality department. Therefore, the industrial engineering students have a lot of space for the development of quality management. 3.Consulting firm engaged in market research, industry consultation and so on. 4.Civil servants are engaged in economic management. 5.University teachers are engaged in teaching and scientific research. Duration: 4 years

duration.text: The Industrial Engineering at Beihang University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3472 USD/per year ￥ 25000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 6. HSK 4

requirements.text: 1. High school graduate or above 2. Aged 18 or above and with a good health 3. No Chinese-citizen with foreign passport
